questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को पढ़िए : अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R)।
अभिकथन (A) : प्रबन्ध के सिद्धांत कार्य के लिए मार्गदर्शक होते हैं, लेकिन सभी प्रबन्धकीय समस्याओं के लिए बने बनाए, सीधे समाधान प्रदान नहीं करते।
कारण (R) : वास्तविक व्यावसायिक परिस्थितियाँ न तो बहुत जटिल होती हैं और न ही गतिशील और बहुत अधिक तत्त्वों का परिणाम नहीं होती हैं।
नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements : Assertion (A) and Reason (R).
Assertion (A) : The principles of management are guidelines to action, but do not provide readymade, straitjacket solutions to all managerial problems.
Reason (R) : Real business situations are neither complex, nor dynamic and are not the result of many factors.
Choose the correct alternative from the options given below :

options.A: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, परन्तु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) सत्य है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) — Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false. The Assertion is correct because management principles are indeed guidelines that help managers take decisions, but they are not rigid rules providing readymade solutions; they must be adapted to varying situations. However, the Reason is false because real business situations are in fact very complex, dynamic, and the result of many interacting factors. Since the Reason incorrectly describes business situations as simple and static, it is false, making option (C) the right choice.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है — अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) असत्य है। अभिकथन सही है क्योंकि प्रबन्ध के सिद्धांत वास्तव में मार्गदर्शक होते हैं, किन्तु कठोर नियम नहीं। कारण असत्य है क्योंकि वास्तविक व्यावसायिक परिस्थितियाँ जटिल, गतिशील और अनेक तत्त्वों का परिणाम होती हैं।

questions.text: _______ के अन्तर्गत, उपभोक्ता को उत्पाद को बदलने, उत्पाद से दोषों को दूर करने, किसी हानि अथवा क्षति के लिए उसकी पूर्ति करने और किसी वस्तु/सेवा को अपेक्षा के अनुरूप न होने पर उपभोक्ता को उससे राहत पाने का अधिकार है।
questions.text_english: Under _________, the consumer has a right to get relief for replacement of the product, removal of defect in the product, compensation paid for any loss or injury suffered by the consumer in case the product/service falls short of his expectations.

options.D: शिकायत (सुनवाई) का अधिकार

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) — Right to seek redressal. This right entitles a consumer to seek relief in the form of replacement of goods, removal of defects, or compensation for any loss or injury suffered when a product or service does not meet expectations. Right to safety protects against hazardous goods, Right to be heard allows consumers to file complaints, and Right to be assured is not a standard consumer right under the Consumer Protection Act. Only the Right to seek redressal covers replacement, defect removal, and compensation.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) है — क्षतिपूर्ति (निवारण पाने का) का अधिकार। यह अधिकार उपभोक्ता को उत्पाद बदलवाने, दोष दूर करवाने या हानि की भरपाई पाने का अधिकार देता है।

questions.text: कॉलम I में दिए गए संगठन प्रक्रिया के चरणों का कॉलम II में दी गई उसकी व्याख्या से मिलान कीजिए।
questions.text_english: Match the steps of organising process given in Column I with their explanation given in Column II.
questions.instruction_line: निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: Choose the correct option from the following :
questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) — 1-(iii), 2-(ii), 3-(iv), 4-(i). Identification and division of work (1) matches with (iii) because this step involves identifying activities as per plans and dividing them to avoid duplication. Departmentalisation (2) matches with (ii) because it groups similar activities together. Assignment of duties (3) matches with (iv) because it involves defining job positions and allocating work to employees. Establishing authority and reporting relationships (4) matches with (i) because it creates the hierarchical structure and helps coordination among departments.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है। कार्य की पहचान व विभाजन — (iii), विभागीकरण — (ii), कर्तव्यों का निर्धारण — (iv), अधिकार व वृत्तांत सम्बन्ध — (i)।

questions.text: 'ग्राहकों की आवश्यकताओं की पहचान करने और उत्पाद एवं सेवाओं के सफल विपणन सम्बन्धी विभिन्न निर्णयों को लेने के लिए यह महत्त्वपूर्ण है कि उपलब्ध सुअवसरों एवं खतरों तथा संगठन की सुदृढ़ता एवं कमज़ोरियों का विश्लेषण किया जाए और यह निर्णय लिया जाए कि किन सुअवसरों का लाभ उठाने के लिए कार्य किया जाए', विपणन के एक कार्य पर प्रकाश डालता है, वह है :
questions.text_english: 'To identify the needs of the customers and to take various decisions related to successful marketing of the products and services, it is important to make an analysis of the available opportunities and threats, as well as strengths and weaknesses of the organisation and decide what opportunities can be best pursued by it', highlights one of the functions of marketing, that is :

options.A: बाज़ार सम्बन्धी सूचना एकत्रित करना तथा उसका विश्लेषण करना
options.D: ब्रान्डिंग

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) — gathering and analysing market information. The statement describes analysing opportunities, threats, strengths, and weaknesses (SWOT) to identify customer needs and make marketing decisions. This is precisely the function of gathering and analysing market information, which involves collecting data about the market environment and interpreting it for strategic decision-making. Marketing planning involves setting objectives and strategies, while product designing and branding are separate distinct functions.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है — बाज़ार सम्बन्धी सूचना एकत्रित करना तथा उसका विश्लेषण करना।

questions.text: 'प्रबन्ध का वह सिद्धान्त जो संगठन में कार्य करने के लिए आवश्यक संगठनात्मक नियमों एवं रोजगार समझौतों का पालन करने पर बल देता है', कहलाता है :
questions.text_english: 'The principle of management which emphasizes on obedience to organisational rules and employment agreements necessary for the working of the organisation' is called :

options.D: कर्मचारियों का प्रतिफल

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) — Discipline. Fayol's principle of Discipline requires obedience, proper conduct, and respect for organisational rules and employment agreements. Division of work relates to specialisation, Scalar chain refers to the chain of authority from top to bottom, and Remuneration deals with fair pay. Only Discipline specifically emphasizes adherence to rules and agreements necessary for organisational functioning.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) है — अनुशासन। फेयोल का यह सिद्धांत संगठनात्मक नियमों और रोजगार समझौतों का पालन करने पर बल देता है।

questions.text: स्थायी वित्तीय प्रभारों की उपस्थिति के कारण समता अंशधारियों द्वारा अर्जित लाभ में वृद्धि जानी जाती है :
questions.text_english: The increase in profit earned by the equity shareholders due to the presence of fixed financial charges is known as :

options.D: वित्तीय उत्तोलक

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) — Trading on equity. Trading on equity refers to the use of fixed-interest or fixed-dividend bearing capital (like debentures or preference shares) to magnify the return on equity shares. When the rate of return on total investment exceeds the fixed charges payable on borrowed funds, the surplus benefits the equity shareholders, increasing their earnings. Financial leverage is a broader concept, financial risk refers to the risk of not meeting fixed obligations, and financial planning is about estimating financial needs.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है — समता पर व्यापार। यह स्थिर वित्तीय प्रभारों के कारण समता अंशधारियों के लाभ में होने वाली वृद्धि को दर्शाता है।

questions.text: वैज्ञानिक प्रबन्ध की एक तकनीक के रूप में 'कार्यात्मक फोरमैनशिप' के सम्बन्ध में गलत कथन को पहचानिए :
questions.text_english: Identify the incorrect statement with respect to 'functional foremanship' as a technique of scientific management :

options.A: यह नियोजन एवं क्रियान्वयन कार्यों को अलग-अलग करने की वकालत करता है।
options.B: गति नायक, टोली नायक, मरम्मत नायक तथा निरीक्षक उत्पादन प्रभारी (प्रबन्धक) के अन्तर्गत कार्य करते हैं।
options.C: यह आदेश की एकता के सिद्धांत का निम्नतम स्तर तक विस्तार है।
options.D: उत्पादन प्रक्रिया में प्रत्येक कर्मचारी को आठ फोरमैनों से आदेश लेने होते हैं।

options_english.A: It advocates separation of planning and execution functions.
options_english.B: Speed boss, gang boss, repair boss and inspector work under the production incharge.
options_english.C: It is an extension of the principle of unity of command to the shop floor.
options_english.D: Each worker takes orders from eight foremen in the process of production.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) — 'It is an extension of the principle of unity of command to the shop floor.' This statement is incorrect. Functional foremanship actually violates the principle of unity of command because each worker receives orders from multiple foremen (up to eight) specialised in different functions. It does not extend unity of command but rather breaks it. Options (A), (B), and (D) are all correct descriptions of functional foremanship as conceived by F.W. Taylor.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है। यह कथन गलत है क्योंकि कार्यात्मक फोरमैनशिप आदेश की एकता के सिद्धांत का उल्लंघन करती है, विस्तार नहीं।

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए :
कथन I : एकल-उपयोग योजना का उपयोग एक समय अवधि में नियमित रूप से होने वाली गतिविधियों के लिए किया जाता है।
कथन II : नीतियाँ स्थायी योजनाओं का साधारण रूप है जो एक निश्चित स्थिति के लिए संगठन की प्रतिक्रिया को निर्दिष्ट करती हैं।
उपर्युक्त कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully :
Statement I : A single-use plan is used for activities that occur regularly over a period of time.
Statement II : Policies are a general form of standing plans that specify the organisation's response to a certain situation.
In the light of the above statements, choose the correct alternative from the following :

options.A: कथन I सत्य है तथा कथन II असत्य है।
options.B: कथन I असत्य है तथा कथन II सत्य है।
options.C: कथन I तथा कथन II दोनों सत्य हैं।
options.D: कथन I तथा कथन II दोनों असत्य हैं।

options_english.A: Statement I is true and Statement II is false.
options_english.B: Statement I is false and Statement II is true.
options_english.C: Both Statement I and Statement II are true.
options_english.D: Both Statement I and Statement II are false.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) — Statement I is false and Statement II is true. Statement I is incorrect because single-use plans are made for non-repetitive, unique activities that occur once — for example, a budget for a specific project. It is the standing plans that are used for recurring activities. Statement II is correct because policies are indeed a type of standing plan that provide a general guideline specifying how an organisation will respond to a particular situation.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) है। कथन I असत्य है क्योंकि एकल-उपयोग योजना एक बार होने वाली गतिविधियों के लिए बनती है। कथन II सत्य है क्योंकि नीतियाँ स्थायी योजनाएं हैं।

questions.text:
यदि कोई निवेशक कोई प्रतिभूति खरीदना या बेचना चाहता है, तो उसे पहले एक पंजीकृत दलाल या उप-दलाल से सम्पर्क तथा उसके साथ एक समझौता करना पड़ता है। निवेशक को प्रतिभूतियों को खरीदने अथवा बेचने का आदेश देने से पहले एक दलाल-ग्राहक समझौते तथा एक ग्राहक पंजीकरण फॉर्म पर हस्ताक्षर करने होते हैं। उसके बाद निवेशक को डिपॉजिटरी पार्टिसिपेंट (मध्यस्थ) के साथ एक 'डीमैट' खाता या 'लाभकारी स्वामी' खाता प्रतिभूतियों को डीमैट रूप में रखने व उन्हें हस्तान्तरित करने के लिए खोलना होता है तथा प्रतिभूति बाज़ार में नगद लेनदेनों के लिए एक बैंक खाता खोलना होता है। शेयर बाज़ार में 'व्यापार एवं निपटान प्रक्रिया' के प्रथम दो चरणों की चर्चा उपर्युक्त पंक्तियों में की गई है। अगले चार चरणों को सही क्रम में लगाइए :
(i) उसके बाद दलाल को ऑनलाइन जाकर मुख्य स्टॉक एक्सचेंज से अपने आप को जोड़ना होता है और शेयर का उसकी उपलब्ध सबसे अच्छी कीमत के साथ मिलान करना होता है।
(ii) व्यापार (क्रय-विक्रय) के पूरा होने के बाद 24 घंटे के अन्दर दलाल एक अनुबंध नोट जारी करता है।
(iii) इसके बाद निवेशक दलाल को शेयरों को खरीदने या बेचने का आदेश देता है। शेयरों की संख्या तथा किस मूल्य पर शेयरों को खरीदा या बेचा जाएगा इस सम्बन्ध में स्पष्ट निर्देश दिए जाने चाहिए।
(iv) उल्लिखित कीमत पर जब अंशों को खरीदा या बेचा जा सकता है, तो इसे दलाल टर्मिनल पर सूचित करना होगा और आदेश इलेक्ट्रॉनिक रूप से निष्पादित किया जाएगा।
questions.text_english:
If an investor wishes to buy or sell any security, he/she has to first approach a registered broker or sub-broker and enter into an agreement with him. An investor has to sign a broker-client agreement and a client registration form before placing an order to buy or sell securities. Thereafter, the investor has to open a 'Demat' account or 'Beneficial owner' account with a depository participant for holding and transferring securities in the demat form and a bank account for cash transactions in the securities market. The first two steps of 'Trading and Settlement procedure' in stock market have been discussed in the above lines. Place the next four steps in the correct order :
(i) The broker will then go online and connect to the main stock exchange and match the share and best price available.
(ii) After the trade has been executed, within 24 hours the broker issues a contract note.
(iii) The investor then places an order with the broker to buy or sell shares. Clear instructions have to be given about the number of shares and the price at which the shares should be bought or sold.
(iv) When the shares can be bought or sold at the price mentioned, it will be communicated to the broker's terminal and the order will be executed electronically.
questions.instruction_line: निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.instruction_line_english: Choose the correct option from the following :

options.D: (iii), (iv), (i), (ii)

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) — (iii), (i), (iv), (ii). After opening the Demat and bank accounts (steps 1 and 2), the correct sequence is: first the investor places an order with the broker (iii), then the broker connects online to the stock exchange and matches the best price (i), then when the shares are available at the stated price the order is executed electronically (iv), and finally within 24 hours the broker issues a contract note (ii). This reflects the standard trading and settlement sequence in Indian stock markets.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है — (iii), (i), (iv), (ii)। पहले निवेशक आदेश देता है, फिर दलाल मिलान करता है, फिर इलेक्ट्रॉनिक निष्पादन होता है और अंत में अनुबंध नोट जारी होता है।

questions.text:
रघु, जब प्रात:काल उठता था, तो अधिकतर पीठ दर्द की शिकायत करता था। जब उसका यह दर्द बना रहने लगा, तो उसने एक डॉक्टर से परामर्श लिया जिसने उसे एक अच्छी गुणवत्ता वाले ऑर्थोपेडिक गद्दे को खरीदने की सलाह दी। इससे उसकी रीढ़ की हड्डी का सही सरेखण सुनिश्चित होगा तथा पीठ का दर्द कम होगा। रघु ने बाज़ार का सर्वेक्षण किया और एक अच्छी गुणवत्ता वाला ऑर्थोपेडिक गद्दा खरीदा। चूँकि गद्दे का मूल्य बहुत अधिक था, वह माल एवं सेवा कर (जीएसटी) का भुगतान करने से बचना चाहता था। दुकानदार ने उसे सुझाव दिया कि वह ऐसा कर सकता है, यदि वह गद्दे को खरीदने की रसीद न ले। रघु इसके लिए तुरंत सहमत हो गया। गद्दे का कुछ महीने प्रयोग करने बाद, उसका पीठ दर्द दोबारा हो गया। उसने यह अनुभव किया कि गद्दा बीच में से अंदर धंस गया है। उसने दुकानदार से सम्पर्क किया जिसने रघु की बात सुनने से मना कर दिया। रघु अपनी शिकायत के निवारण के लिए न्यायालय जाना चाहता था। लेकिन उसके एक मित्र ने उससे कहा कि वह ऐसा नहीं कर सकता क्योंकि उसने अपने एक उत्तरदायित्व को पूरा नहीं किया था।
निम्नलिखित में से उस उत्तरदायित्व की पहचान कीजिए जिसे रघु पूरा करने में असफल रहा :
questions.text_english:
Raghu, on waking up early in the morning, often complained about back pain. When his pain persisted, he consulted a doctor who advised him to purchase a good quality orthopedic mattress. That would ensure correct spinal alignment and reduce the back pain. Raghu surveyed the market and purchased a good quality orthopedic mattress. As the price of the mattress was very high, he wanted to avoid paying GST. The shopkeeper suggested that he can do so if he does not take a receipt for the purchase of the mattress. Raghu readily agreed for the same. After few months of using the mattress, his back pain recurred. He realised that the mattress had caved in from the centre. He approached the shopkeeper who refused to entertain Raghu. Raghu wanted to approach the court for redressal of his grievance. However, one of his friends told him that he would not be able to do so as he had not fulfilled one of his responsibilities.
From the following, identify the responsibility which Raghu failed to fulfill :

options.A: पर्यावरण का ध्यान रखें। कूड़ा, कचरा एवं प्रदूषण फैलाने से बचें।
options.B: वस्तुओं एवं सेवाओं की खरीद पर नकद रसीद माँगें।
options.C: यह सुनिश्चित करने के लिए कि आपके साथ सही व्यवहार हो, अपनी दृढ़ता का परिचय दें।
options.D: उत्पादों एवं सेवाओं से जुड़े जोखिमों के सम्बन्ध में जानें, निर्माता के दिशा-निर्देशों का पालन करें और उत्पादों का ध्यान से उपयोग करें।

options_english.A: Respect the environment. Avoid waste, littering and contributing to pollution.
options_english.B: Ask for a Cash Memo on purchase of goods and services.
options_english.C: Assert yourself to ensure that you get a fair deal.
options_english.D: Learn about the risks associated with products and services, follow manufacturers instructions and use the product safely.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) — Ask for a Cash Memo on purchase of goods and services. Raghu agreed not to take a receipt (cash memo) to avoid paying GST. As a consumer, it is a fundamental responsibility to insist on obtaining a cash memo or receipt for every purchase. Without proof of purchase, a consumer cannot approach a consumer court for redressal. Since Raghu failed to get the receipt, he cannot legally seek redressal, which is why his friend correctly pointed out that he cannot approach the court.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) है। रघु ने जीएसटी बचाने के लिए रसीद नहीं ली। रसीद न होने पर वह उपभोक्ता न्यायालय नहीं जा सकता।

questions.text: निम्नलिखित में से कौन-सी प्रबन्ध के नियोजन कार्य की एक सीमा नहीं है ?
questions.text_english: Which of the following is not a limitation of planning function of management ?

options.B: नियोजन रचनात्मकता को कम करता है।
options.C: नियोजन सफलता का आश्वासन देता है।
options.D: (हो सकता है) नियोजन परिवर्तनशील वातावरण में प्रभावी नहीं रहता (रहे)।

options_english.D: Planning may not work in a dynamic environment.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) — Planning guarantees success. This is NOT a limitation of planning; it is actually a misconception. Planning does not guarantee success — it only reduces risk and provides direction. The actual limitations of planning include that it leads to rigidity (A), reduces creativity among employees (B), and may not be effective in a rapidly changing dynamic environment (D). Saying that planning guarantees success is incorrect, which is why it cannot be a stated limitation.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है। 'नियोजन सफलता का आश्वासन देता है' — यह नियोजन की सीमा नहीं है। यह एक भ्रांति है। नियोजन सफलता की गारंटी नहीं देता।

questions.text:
बुलेटी में ऑटोमोबाइल्स की बढ़ती हुई माँग को देखते हुए, एक वैश्विक कार निर्माणी कम्पनी 'वेसो कार्स' ने अपने संचालनों का विकास करने और वहाँ अपनी कारों को बेचने की योजना बनाई। लेकिन बुलेटी की सरकार ने स्थानीय निर्माताओं का विदेशी प्रतिस्पर्धियों से संरक्षण करने के लिए विदेशों में बनी कारों पर भारी आयात कर लगा दिए। बुलेटी सरकार के विदेशी कार निर्माताओं के प्रति इस मनोभाव से आयातित कारों की लागत बढ़ गई जिससे 'वेसो कार्स' के लिए बुलेटी में प्रतिस्पर्धात्मक मूल्यों पर अपनी कारों का बेचना कम किफायती हो गया।
उपर्युक्त में व्यावसायिक पर्यावरण के जिस घटक पर प्रकाश डाला गया है, वह है :
questions.text_english:
Seeing the increasing demand for automobiles in Buleti, 'Veso Cars', a global car manufacturing company planned to expand its operations and sell its cars there. However, the government of Buleti imposed high import duties on foreign made cars to protect local manufacturers from foreign competition. This attitude of the Buleti government towards foreign car manufacturers increased the cost of importing cars, making it less affordable for 'Veso Cars' to sell its cars at competitive prices in Buleti.
The component of business environment highlighted above is :

options.D: आर्थिक पर्यावरण

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) — Political environment. The political environment refers to the influence of government policies, political stability, and the attitude of the government towards businesses. In this case, the government of Buleti imposed high import duties as a deliberate policy decision to protect local manufacturers — this is a political decision reflecting the government's attitude towards foreign businesses. Legal environment would refer to specific laws already enacted, whereas here the emphasis is on the government's attitude and policy stance.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है — राजनीतिक पर्यावरण। सरकार की नीति और विदेशी व्यवसायों के प्रति उसका दृष्टिकोण राजनीतिक पर्यावरण को दर्शाता है।

questions.text: 'निर्देशन' के महत्त्व के सम्बन्ध में गलत कथन की पहचान कीजिए :
questions.text_english: Identify the incorrect statement with respect to importance of 'Directing' :

options.A: यह कार्य को प्रारंभ करने में सहायता करता है।
options.B: यह संगठन में स्थिरता तथा संतुलन बनाए रखने में सहायता करता है।
options.C: यह संगठन में आवश्यक परिवर्तनों को प्रारंभ करने में मदद करता है।
options.D: यह नियंत्रण के लिए मानक स्थापित करता है।

options_english.B: It helps to bring stability and balance in the organisation.
options_english.C: It facilitates introduction of needed changes in the organisation.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) — 'It establishes standards for controlling.' This statement is incorrect with respect to the importance of Directing. Establishing standards for control is a function of Controlling, not Directing. Directing helps to initiate action (A), maintains stability and balance (B), and facilitates the introduction of required changes (C). Controlling is the function that sets standards and compares actual performance against them.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (D) है। नियंत्रण के लिए मानक स्थापित करना 'नियंत्रण' का कार्य है, 'निर्देशन' का नहीं।

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को पढ़िए : अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R)।
अभिकथन (A) : एक क्रेता किसी वस्तु अथवा सेवा का क्रय इसलिए करता है क्योंकि यह उसके लिए उपयोगी है अथवा उसे यह कुछ लाभ पहुँचाती है।
कारण (R) : ग्राहक के दृष्टिकोण से उत्पाद अनेक उपयोगिताओं का समूह है जिसका क्रय उसकी कुछ आवश्यकताओं की संतुष्टि की क्षमता के कारण किया जाता है।
नीचे दिए गए विकल्पों में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements : Assertion (A) and Reason (R).
Assertion (A) : A buyer buys a product or service for what it does for him/her or the benefit it provides to him/her.
Reason (R) : From the customer's point of view, a product is a bundle of utilities which is purchased because of its capability to provide satisfaction of a certain need.
Choose the correct alternative from the options given below :

options.A: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं तथा कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या है।
options.B: अभिकथन (A) तथा कारण (R) दोनों सत्य हैं, परन्तु कारण (R), अभिकथन (A) की सही व्याख्या नहीं है।
options.C: अभिकथन (A) सत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) असत्य है।
options.D: अभिकथन (A) असत्य है, परन्तु कारण (R) सत्य है।

options_english.A: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.B: Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true, but Reason (R) is not the correct explanation of Assertion (A).
options_english.C: Assertion (A) is true, but Reason (R) is false.
options_english.D: Assertion (A) is false, but Reason (R) is true.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) — Both Assertion (A) and Reason (R) are true and Reason (R) is the correct explanation of Assertion (A). The Assertion correctly states that a buyer purchases a product for the benefit it provides. The Reason correctly explains why — because from the customer's perspective, a product is a bundle of utilities capable of satisfying needs. The Reason directly and logically explains the Assertion: buyers purchase for benefits because products represent bundles of utilities satisfying needs.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है। अभिकथन और कारण दोनों सत्य हैं और कारण, अभिकथन की सही व्याख्या करता है।

questions.text:
'ग्रीन टेक सोल्यूशन्स', जो पर्यावरण-अनुकूल उत्पादों का निर्माता है, के संगठनात्मक ढाँचे में उत्पादन, विपणन, विक्रय, आदि के अलग-अलग विभाग थे। प्रत्येक विभाग के अपने-अपने उद्देश्य, नीतियाँ और काम करने का तरीका था। कम्पनी चुनौतियों का सामना कर रही थी क्योंकि उत्पादन विभाग, विक्रय विभाग से परामर्श लिए बिना वस्तुओं के उत्पादन पर अपना ध्यान केन्द्रित कर रहा था तथा विपणन विभाग उत्पादन समय-रेखा को ध्यान में रखे बिना ही विज्ञापन अभियान विकसित कर रहा था जिससे भ्रम एवं संघर्ष बढ़ रहे थे। इसके समाधान के लिए, मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी मधुर ने अंतर्विभागीय बैठक का आयोजन किया और सम्बन्धित प्रबंधकों को समझाया कि अपनी क्रियाओं का निष्पादन करते समय उन्हें एक-दूसरे से परामर्श करना है। सभी विभागीय प्रबंधक इससे सहमत हो गए। सभी विभागों की क्रियाओं को एक-दूसरे से जोड़कर मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी यह सुनिश्चित करने में सक्षम हो गया कि आवश्यकता के समय उचित वस्तुएँ उपलब्ध हो जाएँ, विपणन प्रयासों का उत्पाद की उपलब्धता के साथ मिलान हो जाए तथा विक्रय लक्ष्य प्राप्त हो जाएँ।
प्रबन्ध की वह अवधारणा, जिसका अनुपालन मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी ने विभागों के बीच भ्रम एवं संघर्ष का समाधान करने के लिए किया, थी :
questions.text_english:
'Green Tech Solutions', a manufacturer of eco-friendly products had an organisational structure with separate departments for production, marketing, sales, etc. Each department had its own objectives, policies and style of working. The company was facing challenges as the production department would focus on producing goods without consulting the sales department and the marketing department developed advertising campaigns without considering the production timelines, leading to confusion and conflicts. To resolve this, the Chief Executive Officer, Madhur arranged inter-departmental meetings explaining to the respective managers that they have to consult each other while performing their activities. All the departmental managers agreed to this. By linking the activities of all the departments, the Chief Executive Officer was able to ensure that the right products are available when needed, marketing efforts match with the product availability and sales targets are achieved.
The concept of management followed by the Chief Executive Officer to resolve confusion and conflicts between departments was :

options.D: नियुक्तिकरण

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) — Coordination. Coordination is the process of synchronising the activities of different departments to ensure unity of action and common purpose. The CEO linked the activities of production, marketing, and sales departments so that they worked together harmoniously. This is the essence of coordination — integrating diverse departmental activities to achieve organisational goals. Organising deals with structure, planning with goal-setting, and staffing with workforce management.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) है — समन्वय। मुख्य कार्यकारी अधिकारी ने सभी विभागों की क्रियाओं को एकसाथ जोड़कर समन्वय की अवधारणा का अनुपालन किया।

questions.text:
निम्नलिखित कथनों को ध्यानपूर्वक पढ़िए :
कथन I : नियोजन एवं नियंत्रण दोनों पीछे की क्रियाओं का अवलोकन तथा भविष्य की क्रियाओं का अवलोकन करने वाले कार्य हैं।
कथन II : नियोजन निर्देशात्मक है जबकि नियंत्रण मूल्यांकनात्मक है।
दिए गए कथनों के आलोक में, निम्नलिखित में से सही विकल्प का चयन कीजिए :
questions.text_english:
Read the following statements carefully :
Statement I : Planning and Controlling are both backward-looking as well as forward-looking functions.
Statement II : Planning is prescriptive whereas Controlling is evaluative.
In light of given statements, choose the correct alternative from the following :

options.A: कथन I सत्य है तथा कथन II असत्य है।
options.B: कथन I असत्य है तथा कथन II सत्य है।
options.C: कथन I तथा कथन II दोनों सत्य हैं।
options.D: कथन I तथा कथन II दोनों असत्य हैं।

options_english.A: Statement I is true and Statement II is false.
options_english.B: Statement I is false and Statement II is true.
options_english.C: Both Statement I and Statement II are true.
options_english.D: Both Statement I and Statement II are false.

questions.solution: The correct answer is (C) — Both Statement I and Statement II are true. Planning is forward-looking as it prepares for future actions, but it also looks backward to learn from past performance; similarly, controlling is backward-looking (it measures actual vs. planned) but also forward-looking (it corrects deviations to improve future). Hence Statement I is true. Statement II is also correct: planning is prescriptive as it prescribes what should be done, while controlling is evaluative as it evaluates what has been done.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (C) है। दोनों कथन सत्य हैं। नियोजन निर्देशात्मक और नियंत्रण मूल्यांकनात्मक होता है। दोनों अतीत और भविष्य दोनों पर दृष्टि रखते हैं।

questions.text: नीचे दिए गए चित्र में दर्शाए गए वित्तीय प्रोत्साहन की पहचान कीजिए :
questions.text_english: Identify the financial incentive shown in the picture given below :

options.D: सेवानिवृत्ति लाभ

questions.solution: The correct answer is (D) — Retirement benefits. The picture shows the Employee Provident Fund (EPF), where both the employer and the employee contribute a fixed portion of wages into a provident fund account. This fund accumulates over the employee's working life and is paid out upon retirement. EPF is therefore a retirement benefit, not a stock option, perquisite, or productivity-linked incentive. It is specifically classified as a financial incentive under the category of retirement benefits.

questions.text_english:
After moving to Dama from his home town in Rasha, Ramu and his family were staying in a rented accommodation for the last 5 years. Ramu and one of his office colleagues decided to buy a flat each in close proximity to their office. After a lot of research, they settled for a housing project which would cost them ₹1·25 crore each for a three bedroom flat. The housing project developers promised to deliver their flats within 36 months. An amount of ₹20 lakh each was paid to the developers of the housing project at the time of booking the flat. Since the payment schedule was time bound, they paid additional ₹80 lakh each over a period of 2 years. The balance of ₹25 lakh was to be paid at the time of registration. Despite having taken the major part of the cost of the flats, the housing project developers hadn't started the construction work. Ramu and his colleague asked the housing project developers to refund the amount paid. On refusal of refund of the amount paid by the housing project developers, Ramu and his colleague decided to approach the consumer court.
The redressal agency which Ramu and his colleague should approach for redressal of their grievance is :

options.D: स्थानीय कमीशन

questions.solution: The correct answer is (B) — State Commission. Each person paid ₹20 lakh + ₹80 lakh = ₹1 crore. The total amount in dispute for each complainant is ₹1 crore. Under the Consumer Protection Act 2019, the State Commission has jurisdiction over complaints where the value of goods/services and the compensation claimed exceeds ₹1 crore but does not exceed ₹10 crore. Since the claim is ₹1 crore (which exceeds the District Commission's limit of up to ₹1 crore), the State Commission is the appropriate forum. The National Commission handles claims above ₹10 crore.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (B) है — राज्य कमीशन। प्रत्येक ने ₹1 करोड़ का भुगतान किया। उपभोक्ता संरक्षण अधिनियम 2019 के अनुसार ₹1 करोड़ से अधिक और ₹10 करोड़ तक के मामले राज्य कमीशन में जाते हैं।

questions.text_english:
'Alpha Manufacturing Ltd.' is a company manufacturing high quality car spare parts. The company has a well-established production line and its products are highly demanded in the market. However, it was noticed that the defect rate in the manufacturing process was higher than the standard of 10 per 1,000 pieces produced. In spite of best efforts, the Production Manager was not able to reduce the defect rate. So, he decided to revise the standards.
The step of the controlling process, followed by the Production Manager after not being able to reduce the defect rate, will be :

options.D: वास्तविक निष्पादन की मानकों से तुलना करना

questions.solution: The correct answer is (A) — Taking corrective action. The controlling process involves setting standards, measuring actual performance, comparing with standards, analysing deviations, and taking corrective action. Revising the standards itself is a form of corrective action when the deviation cannot be corrected by other means. After comparing performance with standards and analysing that the defect rate cannot be reduced, the Production Manager takes corrective action by revising the standards. This is the final step of the controlling process.
questions.solution_hindi: सही उत्तर (A) है — सुधारात्मक कार्यवाही करना। जब विचलन को अन्य तरीकों से ठीक नहीं किया जा सके, तो मानकों का संशोधन भी सुधारात्मक कार्यवाही का ही हिस्सा है।

sub_questions.text_english:
Explain the following points of importance of 'Controlling' function of management :
(i) Ensuring order and discipline
(ii) Judging accuracy of standards

key_points: Ensuring order and discipline: controlling helps maintain order by monitoring employee behavior and ensuring adherence to rules
Judging accuracy of standards: the controlling process reveals whether the standards set during planning were realistic or need revision

sub_questions.solution: Controlling helps in ensuring order and discipline by continuously monitoring the activities of employees. When employees know that their performance is being measured and evaluated against set standards, they tend to work responsibly and avoid misconduct, thereby maintaining order in the organisation. Regarding judging accuracy of standards, the controlling process compares actual performance with planned standards. If actual performance consistently falls short, it indicates that the standards may have been set too high and are unrealistic. Conversely, if performance consistently exceeds standards, they may be too low. Thus, controlling helps managers judge whether the standards themselves are accurate and achievable, and revise them if necessary.

sub_questions.solution: Staffing is a vital function of management for three key reasons. Second, it ensures optimum utilisation of the human resources already available by training and developing existing employees, thereby reducing wastage of talent. Third, it improves overall organisational performance because when the right person is placed in the right job, their skills are fully utilised, leading to greater efficiency, higher morale, and better results for the organisation.

questions.text_english:
Sweets has been the mainstay for several large homegrown restaurant brands. Increased life expectancy of people and increased awareness for health care amongst consumers has increased the demand for healthy food options. Young consumers are moving away from consuming traditional sweets to buying more western style premium products which are baked or steamed. With this shift in consumer preferences, 'Shree Restaurants', a well known restaurant brand, is gearing itself up for playing a greater role in the healthy packaged foods market. In addition to traditional sweets, the company is also planning to expand to healthy savoury and sweet items and some ready-to-eat items. These new healthy products are expected to change people's lifestyles.
Identify and explain the two features of Business Environment highlighted in the above case.

key_points: Dynamic nature: business environment keeps changing (shift in consumer preferences from traditional sweets to healthy options)
Interrelatedness: changes in one aspect (health awareness) affect another (demand for healthy foods and business strategy)

questions.solution: The two features of Business Environment highlighted in the above case are as follows. The first feature is the Dynamic nature of business environment. The business environment is constantly changing. In the given case, consumer preferences have shifted from traditional sweets to healthier western-style baked and steamed products. This shift forced Shree Restaurants to adapt its product offerings by entering the healthy packaged foods market, demonstrating that the environment is never static. The second feature is Interrelatedness. Various elements of the business environment are interconnected and influence each other. In this case, increased life expectancy and growing health awareness (social and demographic factors) directly led to a change in consumer demand, which in turn influenced Shree Restaurants' business strategy and product planning. This shows how changes in one dimension trigger changes in others.

sub_questions.text_english:
Explain the following internal sources of recruitment :
(i) Transfers
(ii) Promotions

key_points: Transfer: lateral movement of an employee from one job/department/location to another at a similar level
Promotion: vertical upward movement of an employee to a higher position with greater responsibility, status, and pay

sub_questions.solution: Transfer refers to the lateral movement of an existing employee from one job, department, or branch to another at a similar level of responsibility and pay. It fills a vacancy without recruiting from outside and helps utilize existing talent across the organisation. It does not involve a significant change in rank or salary but changes the place or nature of work. Promotion, on the other hand, refers to the vertical upward movement of an employee to a higher position carrying greater responsibility, authority, better pay, and higher status. It acts as a strong non-financial and financial motivator. Promoting from within boosts employee morale, rewards loyalty, and fills senior positions with individuals already familiar with the organisational culture and operations.

Explain the following methods of training :
(i) Internship training
(ii) Vestibule training

key_points: Internship training: educational institutions send trainees to organisations for practical work experience alongside theoretical knowledge
Vestibule training: employees are trained in a simulated work environment separate from the actual workplace

sub_questions.solution: Internship training is a method where educational institutions enter into arrangements with business firms to provide practical on-the-job training to their students. The trainee works in the organisation for a specified period, gaining hands-on experience that complements the theoretical knowledge acquired in the classroom. It bridges the gap between academic learning and real-world work. Vestibule training involves setting up a training centre within the organisation that simulates the actual work environment, equipped with the same tools, machines, and conditions as the real workplace. Employees are trained here before being deployed on the actual job. This method is particularly useful when the actual job environment is too risky or complex for untrained personnel, allowing them to develop skills without disrupting regular operations.

(i) Planning provides direction.
(ii) Planning reduces the risk of uncertainty.

key_points: Planning provides direction by setting goals and outlining how to achieve them
Planning reduces uncertainty by anticipating future changes and preparing responses in advance

sub_questions.solution: Planning provides direction by clearly stating the organisational goals and specifying the courses of action to be followed to achieve them. All departments and employees work in accordance with the plan, ensuring that their efforts are coordinated and focused towards common objectives. Without planning, activities become random and misdirected. Planning reduces the risk of uncertainty by preparing for anticipated future changes. (i) Planning is futuristic.
(ii) Planning is a mental exercise.

key_points: Planning is futuristic: it always looks ahead to achieve future goals
Planning is a mental exercise: it involves thinking, reasoning, and intellectual effort

sub_questions.solution: Planning is futuristic in nature because it always involves looking ahead and preparing for future activities. It is based on forecasts and anticipation of future events — a manager prepares plans to achieve objectives that will be realised in the future. It uses information about the past and present to predict what may happen ahead and plan accordingly. Planning is also a mental exercise because it is not a physical or mechanical activity but an intellectual process. It requires managers to think critically, analyse available data, use judgment, and apply logical reasoning to identify the best possible course of action. It demands concentration, foresight, and sound mental effort rather than physical work.

questions.text:
रुशिल ने एक प्रतिष्ठित इलाके में 'आरके हेयर एंड ब्यूटी सैलून' खोला और सैलून में काम करने वाले पन्द्रह लोगों की नियुक्ति की। लेकिन कुछ ही महीनों में उसने देखा कि कर्मचारी एक-एक करके सैलून छोड़ रहे हैं और व्यवसाय अपने मासिक लक्ष्यों को प्राप्त करने में भी सक्षम नहीं था। रुशिल ने अपने प्रबन्धक से कारण पता लगाने के लिए कहा। प्रबन्धक ने सूचना दी कि अकसर आवश्यकतानुसार, हेयर स्टाइलिस्ट को मेकअप कलाकार (आर्टिस्ट) का कार्य करने के लिए कहा जाता है और मेकअप आर्टिस्ट को नाखूनों की देखभाल आदि का कार्य करने के लिए कहा जाता है। परिणामस्वरूप कर्मचारी खुश नहीं हैं और ऐसे सैलून में कार्य करना चाहते हैं जहाँ कार्य उनकी क्षमतानुसार विभाजित हो और उनके विशिष्टीकरण को बढ़ा सकें। प्रबन्धक ने यह भी बताया कि वहाँ न तो बालों की देखभाल, त्वचा की देखभाल या नाखूनों की देखभाल की सामग्री के लिए और न ही कर्मचारियों के लिए कोई निश्चित स्थान है। इससे भ्रम और कार्य में बाधा उत्पन्न होती है और कर्मचारियों के बीच असंतोष और बढ़ जाता है। परिणामस्वरूप, कर्मचारी सैलून को छोड़ते जा रहे हैं जिससे कर्मचारी आवर्त दर बढ़ रही है और अनुभवी कर्मचारियों की कमी हो रही है।
'आरके हेयर एंड ब्यूटी सैलून' में पालन न किए जाने वाले प्रबन्ध के उन दो सिद्धांतों को पहचानिए एवं समझाइए, जिनकी चर्चा उपर्युक्त में की गई है।
questions.text_english:
Rushil opened 'RK Hair and Beauty Salon' in a reputed locality and appointed fifteen people as salon staff. However, within just a few months, he observed that the employees were leaving the salon one by one and the business was not able to meet even the monthly targets. Rushil asked his manager to find out the reason. The manager reported that quite often, according to the requirement, the hair stylist was asked to do the work of a makeup artist and a makeup artist was asked to do nail care, etc. As a result, the employees were not happy and wanted to work at a salon where work was divided according to their competence and would enhance their specialisation. The manager also added that there was neither any fixed place for hair care, skin care or nail care materials nor for the employees. This created confusion and hindrance in the work and led to further dissatisfaction amongst the staff. As a result, the employees kept leaving the salon leading to high employee turnover ratio and a shortage of experienced staff.
Identify and explain the two principles of management discussed above that are not followed in 'RK Hair and Beauty Salon'.

key_points: Division of Work: work should be divided according to specialisation to improve efficiency
Order: there should be a fixed place for everything and everyone in the organisation

questions.solution: The two principles of management that are not being followed at 'RK Hair and Beauty Salon' are as follows. The first principle is Division of Work. According to Fayol, work should be divided into specialised tasks and assigned to workers according to their competence and specialisation. At RK Salon, hair stylists were being asked to do makeup and makeup artists were being asked to do nail care, which violates this principle. When employees are made to perform tasks outside their area of specialisation, efficiency declines, skill development is hindered, and employee dissatisfaction rises, ultimately leading to high turnover. The second principle is Order. This principle states that there must be a fixed place for everything (material order) and a fixed place for everyone (social order). In RK Salon, there was no fixed place for hair care, skin care, or nail care materials, nor any designated space for employees. This created confusion, hampered work, and contributed to employee dissatisfaction. Maintaining proper order ensures smooth workflow and a disciplined work environment.

questions.text: 'बीएनजी लिमिटेड' एक सुप्रसिद्ध कम्पनी है जो टिकाऊ उपभोक्ता वस्तुओं का निर्माण करती है। इसकी एक बड़े पैमाने की निर्माणी इकाई है जहाँ इलेक्ट्रिक केतली, टोस्टर्स, ब्लैन्डर्स, इलेक्ट्रिक आयरन, आदि जैसे उत्पादों का उत्पादन किया जाता है। चूँकि उत्पादन बड़े पैमाने पर किया जाता है, अत: औसत उत्पादन लागत कम होती है। परिणामस्वरूप उत्पाद व्यापक रूप से किफायती मूल्यों पर सम्पूर्ण क्षेत्रों में उपलब्ध होते हैं और इसके मजबूत लाभ मार्जिन में योगदान दे रहे हैं। दूसरी ओर इसी व्यवसाय में 'केएमवी लिमिटेड' टिकाऊ उपभोक्ता वस्तुओं का निर्माण करने वाली एक अन्य सुप्रसिद्ध कम्पनी है, यह भी अच्छे लाभ अर्जित कर रही है। लेकिन 'केएमवी लिमिटेड' का केन्द्र-बिन्दु ऐसे उत्पादों का उत्पादन करना है जो गुणवत्ता, निष्पादन एवं विशेषताओं में श्रेष्ठ हों। अनुसंधान एवं विकास के लिए इसकी एक समर्पित टीम है जो इसकी गुणवत्ता में सुधार के लिए निरंतर काम करती रहती है।
questions.text_english: 'BNG Ltd.' is a reputed company that manufactures consumer durables. It has a large scale manufacturing unit where products like electric kettles, toasters, blenders, electric irons, etc. are manufactured. Since the production is at a large scale, the average cost of production is low. As a result, the products are widely available across areas at affordable prices contributing to its strong profit margins. On the other hand, 'KMV Ltd.', another reputed consumer durables manufacturer in the same business is also earning good profits. However, 'KMV Ltd.' focuses on producing the products which are superior in quality, performance and features. It has a dedicated Research and Development team which continually works to bring improvement in the quality of its products.

sub_questions.text_english: Identify and explain the marketing management philosophy (concepts) followed by 'BNG Ltd.' and 'KMV Ltd.'.

key_points: BNG Ltd. follows the Production Concept — focus on large-scale production to reduce costs and make products widely available
KMV Ltd. follows the Product Concept — focus on superior quality, performance, and continuous improvement

sub_questions.solution: BNG Ltd. follows the Production Concept of marketing management. This concept holds that consumers prefer products that are widely available and affordable. Accordingly, BNG focuses on large-scale production which lowers average production cost, making its products available at competitive prices across all regions. KMV Ltd. follows the Product Concept of marketing management. This concept holds that consumers prefer products that offer the best quality, performance, and features. Accordingly, KMV focuses on producing superior quality products and has a dedicated Research and Development team that continuously works to improve the quality and features of its products.

Ends — Production Concept: profits through high volume sales at low prices; Product Concept: profits through superior quality and continuous improvement

sub_questions.solution: On the basis of main focus, the Production Concept (followed by BNG Ltd.) focuses primarily on production efficiency — producing goods on a large scale so that costs are minimised and products can be made available at affordable prices. The Product Concept aims to achieve profits by commanding a premium price for superior quality products, supported by strong Research and Development investment.

sub_questions.text_english: State any four features of 'Motivation' as an element of Directing.

key_points: Motivation is an internal feeling
Motivation is goal-directed behaviour
Motivation can be positive or negative
Motivation is a complex process

sub_questions.solution: Motivation as an element of directing has four important features. First, motivation is an internal feeling — it arises from within an individual and is influenced by personal needs, desires, and aspirations. Managers cannot directly create motivation but can create conditions that stimulate it. Second, motivation is goal-directed behaviour — it drives employees to work towards specific goals or targets that satisfy their needs, thereby channelling their energy productively. Third, motivation can be positive or negative — positive motivation includes incentives like bonus, promotion, and praise, while negative motivation involves threats of demotion, fines, or termination to induce desired behaviour. Fourth, motivation is a complex process because human needs differ and change over time, making it difficult to apply a uniform motivational approach for all employees.

sub_questions.text_english:
Explain the following non-financial incentives :

(ii) Employee participation

key_points: Job enrichment: adding more meaningful and challenging tasks to an employee's job to increase satisfaction and motivation
Employee participation: involving employees in decision-making, especially for matters affecting them, to increase commitment and motivation

sub_questions.solution: Job enrichment is a non-financial incentive that involves redesigning a job to include more variety, responsibility, and challenging tasks. Rather than performing repetitive and monotonous tasks, employees are given greater autonomy, creative freedom, and opportunities to utilise their skills fully. This makes the job more meaningful and satisfying, thereby increasing motivation and productivity. For example, allowing a salesperson to also plan customer outreach strategies enriches their role. Employee participation refers to involving employees in the decision-making process, particularly for matters that directly affect them. When employees are consulted and their opinions are valued, they feel a sense of ownership and belonging. This increases their commitment to organisational goals, improves morale, and reduces resistance to change. For instance, forming committees that include workers when framing workplace policies is a form of employee participation.

questions.text_english: 'Nurata Ltd.' is a leading manufacturer of clothing in India, known for good quality casual wear as well as formal wear for children. The company is earning good profits and now wants to expand its business by entering into the business of electronics and home appliances too. The management decided to create separate business units, where each unit head would be responsible for a specific product category and for its performance. All key functions, such as marketing, finance, production, etc. would be handled within each unit.

sub_questions.text: 'नुराता लिमिटेड' द्वारा व्यवसाय के विस्तार पर अपनाए जाने वाले संगठनात्मक ढाँचे की पहचान कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: Identify the organizational structure adopted by 'Nurata Ltd.' on expansion of its business.

key_points: Divisional Structure

sub_questions.solution: The organisational structure adopted by Nurata Ltd. is the Divisional Structure. In a divisional structure, separate divisions are created for different product categories (here — clothing, electronics, home appliances), each with its own head and with all key functions like marketing, finance, and production operating independently within each division.

sub_questions.text: उपर्युक्त (क) में पहचाने गए संगठनात्मक ढाँचे के किन्हीं दो लाभों एवं एक हानि का उल्लेख कीजिए।
sub_questions.text_english: State any two advantages and one disadvantage of the organizational structure identified in (a) above.

key_points: Advantage 1: Each division can focus on its own product/market, enabling better performance and accountability
Advantage 2: It facilitates expansion and growth by simply adding new divisions
Disadvantage: Duplication of resources and functions across divisions increases overall costs

sub_questions.solution: Two advantages of Divisional Structure are as follows. First, it facilitates product specialisation and accountability. Each divisional head is fully responsible for the performance of his/her product line, which creates clear accountability and encourages dedication and focus. This leads to quicker decision-making and better results for each product category. Second, it facilitates growth and expansion. Since each division operates independently, the company can easily add new divisions to enter new product or market segments without disrupting existing operations, as Nurata Ltd. is doing by entering electronics and home appliances. sub_questions.text_english:
Explain the following factors affecting working capital requirements of a business :
(i) Nature of business
(ii) Credit availed
(iii) Operating efficiency
(iv) Seasonal factors

key_points: Nature of business: manufacturing needs more WC than trading; service needs less
Credit availed: more credit from suppliers reduces WC needs
Operating efficiency: faster inventory turnover and collection reduces WC needs
Seasonal factors: peak seasons demand more WC than off-seasons

sub_questions.solution: Nature of business significantly affects working capital requirements. Manufacturing companies require large amounts of working capital as they need to maintain stocks of raw materials, work-in-progress, and finished goods, and often have long production cycles. Trading companies require moderate working capital, while service organisations require the least since they do not maintain inventory. Credit availed refers to the credit period extended by suppliers. If a business enjoys longer credit periods from its suppliers, it can delay payments and thus requires less working capital. Conversely, if suppliers demand quick payments, more working capital is needed to meet these obligations. Operating efficiency refers to how efficiently a business manages its operations — faster production cycles, quicker inventory turnover, and prompt collection of debtors reduce the amount of working capital tied up in operations, thereby lowering working capital requirements. Seasonal factors affect businesses that experience fluctuating demand. During peak seasons, businesses must maintain higher stocks and offer more credit to customers, requiring more working capital. During off-seasons, requirements are lower. A sugar mill, for example, needs more working capital during the crushing season than during the lean period.

sub_questions.text_english: Distinguish between 'Money Market' and 'Capital Market' on any six basis.

key_points: Nature of instruments: money market — short-term; capital market — long-term
Duration: money market < 1 year; capital market > 1 year
Risk: money market — low risk; capital market — higher risk
Liquidity: money market — highly liquid; capital market — less liquid
Return: money market — lower return; capital market — higher potential return
Participants: money market — banks, RBI, institutions; capital market — individuals, companies, institutional investors

sub_questions.solution: Money Market and Capital Market can be distinguished on six bases as follows. First, on the basis of nature of instruments: the money market deals in short-term instruments such as Treasury Bills, Commercial Paper, and Certificates of Deposit, while the capital market deals in long-term instruments like equity shares, debentures, and bonds. Second, on the basis of duration: money market instruments have a maturity period of less than one year, whereas capital market instruments have a maturity period exceeding one year or are perpetual. Third, on the basis of risk: instruments in the money market carry low risk because of their short tenure and high creditworthiness of issuers, while capital market instruments carry higher risk due to market fluctuations and longer time horizons. Fourth, on the basis of liquidity: the money market is highly liquid as instruments can be quickly converted into cash, whereas capital market instruments are comparatively less liquid though they can be traded on stock exchanges. Fifth, on the basis of return: money market instruments offer lower returns because of their low risk and short duration, whereas capital market instruments offer the potential for higher returns, especially equity, though they come with greater risk. Sixth, on the basis of participants: the major participants in the money market are the Reserve Bank of India, commercial banks, and financial institutions, while the capital market includes individual retail investors, companies, mutual funds, foreign institutional investors, and insurance companies.

After completing his civil engineering degree, Sankalp decided to start his own business. He started a construction company 'Sankalp Builders'. He entered into an agreement for construction of residential flats on a land of 30 acres. Building of the flats on such a large scale required expensive machinery like bulldozers, excavators, etc. He had the option to buy the machinery or take it on lease. Though Sankalp was in favour of buying, his father advised him to take the decision with caution as construction machinery becomes outdated very fast and needs to be replaced. He also told Sankalp that in future he may think of diversifying his operations and would need funds for that too.
Identify and state any four factors discussed above affecting the fixed capital requirements of 'Sankalp Builders'.

key_points: Nature of business — manufacturing/construction needs heavy fixed capital
Technology upgradation — construction machinery becomes outdated fast, requiring frequent replacement
Alternative availability of leasing — leasing reduces fixed capital needs
Diversification plans — future diversification will require additional fixed capital

questions.solution: The four factors affecting the fixed capital requirements of Sankalp Builders as discussed in the case are as follows. First, Nature of business — Sankalp Builders is a construction company, which by its very nature requires heavy investment in fixed assets such as land, buildings, bulldozers, and excavators. Manufacturing and construction businesses inherently need more fixed capital than trading or service firms. Second, Technology upgradation — Sankalp's father cautioned him that construction machinery becomes outdated very quickly and requires replacement. Industries where technology changes rapidly need to set aside funds for frequent upgradation, which increases fixed capital requirements. This is directly mentioned in the case. Third, Alternative of leasing — Sankalp had the option of taking the machinery on lease rather than buying it. When a firm leases fixed assets, it does not need to invest large sums in purchasing them, thereby reducing fixed capital requirements. If Sankalp opts for leasing, his fixed capital need will be lower. Fourth, Diversification — Sankalp's father advised that in future, Sankalp may think of diversifying into other areas of operations. Diversification into new business lines requires investment in new fixed assets, which increases fixed capital requirements. Therefore, future diversification plans must be considered while estimating fixed capital needs.

sub_questions.text_english: Explain any four major components of physical distribution.

key_points: Order processing: receiving, handling and fulfilling customer orders
Transportation: movement of goods from production to consumption points
Warehousing: storage of goods until needed
Inventory management: maintaining optimal stock levels

sub_questions.solution: The four major components of physical distribution are as follows. First, Order processing involves all activities from receiving a customer's order to delivering the product. It includes order entry, order checking, credit approval, picking and packing, and dispatch. Efficient order processing reduces delays and enhances customer satisfaction. Second, Transportation is the movement of goods from the place of production to the place of consumption. It is the most critical component as it creates place utility. The choice of transport mode (road, rail, air, water) depends on the nature of goods, distance, cost, and urgency. Faster and more efficient transportation reduces delivery time and improves service levels. Third, Warehousing refers to the storage of goods from the time they are produced until they are needed by buyers. Warehouses create time utility by ensuring that goods are available when demand arises. They also help in grading, packaging, and bulk breaking. Fourth, Inventory management involves maintaining the right quantity of stock at the right time to meet customer demand without incurring excessive holding costs. Too much inventory leads to higher storage costs, while too little may result in lost sales. Effective inventory management balances these two extremes and ensures smooth supply to customers.

sub_questions.text_english: Explain any four communication tools used by the marketers to inform and persuade customers about their firm's products.

key_points: Advertising: paid non-personal communication through various media
Personal selling: direct face-to-face communication by salesperson
Sales promotion: short-term incentives to boost sales
Public relations: building positive image through non-paid publicity

sub_questions.solution: The four major communication tools (promotional tools) used by marketers are as follows. First, Advertising is a paid, non-personal form of communication used to inform and persuade large audiences about a product or service through various media such as television, radio, newspapers, social media, and hoardings. It is particularly effective for creating brand awareness and reaching geographically dispersed audiences at a relatively low cost per person. Second, Personal selling involves direct face-to-face interaction between the salesperson and the potential buyer. The salesperson demonstrates the product, addresses queries, and persuades the customer to make a purchase. It is the most effective tool for complex and high-value products as it allows for two-way communication and can be tailored to individual customer needs. Third, Sales promotion includes short-term incentives such as discounts, coupons, free samples, contests, and buy-one-get-one offers that are designed to create immediate demand and boost sales. It supplements advertising and personal selling and is highly effective in inducing trial purchases and clearing excess inventory. Fourth, Public relations (PR) involves activities aimed at building and maintaining a positive image of the company and its products in the minds of the public, media, and other stakeholders through non-paid means such as press releases, sponsorships, events, and corporate social responsibility activities. Good public relations generate credibility and goodwill without the costs associated with advertising.
